children: is in talks to purchase a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial.

A deal may value the unit of Advance Intelligence Group at more than $2 billion, according to a  Bloomberg report on Thursday, which cited people familiar with the matter. Deliberations are ongoing, and no final decisions have been made.
Grab, Atome Financial and Advance Intelligence Group declined to comment to Bloomberg.
Atome’s owner, Advance Intelligence Group, is backed by investors including SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and Warburg Pincus.
Shares of Grab have dropped 40% this year.
